# Proverbs 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** An-answer gentle turns-away wrath, but-a-word painful stirs-up anger.

**2** [The]-tongue-of [the]-wise makes-good knowledge, but-[the]-mouth-of fools pours-out folly.

**3** In-every place [are the]-eyes-of YHWH, watching [the]-evil and-[the]-good.

**4** Healing-of [the]-tongue [is] a-tree-of life, but-crookedness in-it [is] a-breaking-of spirit.

**5** A-fool spurns [the]-discipline-of his-father, but-one-keeping correction is-prudent.

**6** [The]-house-of [the]-righteous [has] much treasure, but-in-[the]-produce-of [the]-wicked [is] trouble.

**7** [The]-lips-of [the]-wise scatter knowledge, but-[the]-heart-of fools [is]-not right.

**8** [The]-sacrifice-of [the]-wicked [is an]-abomination-of YHWH, but-[the]-prayer-of [the]-upright [is] His-delight.

**9** [An]-abomination-of YHWH [is the]-way-of [the]-wicked, but-one-pursuing righteousness He-loves.

**10** Discipline [is]-evil for-one-forsaking [the]-path; one-hating correction will-die.

**11** Sheol and-Abaddon [are] before YHWH; how-much-more [the]-hearts-of [the]-sons-of mankind.

**12** A-scoffer does-not-love one-correcting-him; to [the]-wise-ones he-will-not go.

**13** A-heart joyful makes-good [the]-face, but-in-pain-of heart [the]-spirit [is]-stricken.

**14** [The]-heart-of [the]-discerning seeks knowledge, but-[the]-face-of fools feeds-on folly.

**15** All [the]-days-of [the]-afflicted [are] evil, but-good-of heart — a-feast continually.

**16** Better [is] a-little with-fear-of YHWH, than-treasure great and-turmoil with-it.

**17** Better [is] a-meal-of vegetables where-love [is], than-a-fattened-ox and-hatred with-it.

**18** A-man-of wrath stirs-up strife, but-one-slow-of anger quiets contention.

**19** [The]-way-of [the]-sluggard [is]-like-a-hedge-of thorns, but-[the]-path-of [the]-upright [is]-a-highway.

**20** A-son wise gladdens a-father, but-a-foolish man despises his-mother.

**21** Folly [is] joy to-one-lacking heart, but-a-man-of understanding makes-straight [his]-walking.

**22** Plans-fail for-lack-of counsel, but-in-[the]-multitude-of counselors they-stand.

**23** Joy [is] for-a-man in-[the]-answer-of his-mouth, and-a-word in-its-time — how good!

**24** [The]-path-of life [is] upward for-[the]-wise, in-order-to-turn-away from-Sheol below.

**25** [The]-house-of [the]-proud YHWH tears-down, but-He-establishes [the]-boundary-of [the]-widow.

**26** [An]-abomination-of YHWH [are]-plans-of evil, but-pleasant [are]-words-of purity.

**27** One-troubling his-house [is one]-gaining-unjust-gain, but-one-hating gifts will-live.

**28** [The]-heart-of [the]-righteous ponders to-answer, but-[the]-mouth-of [the]-wicked pours-out evil-things.

**29** Far [is] YHWH from-[the]-wicked, but-[the]-prayer-of [the]-righteous He-hears.

**30** Light-of [the]-eyes gladdens [the]-heart; a-report good makes-fat [the]-bone.

**31** An-ear listening-to correction-of life in-[the]-midst-of [the]-wise will-lodge.

**32** One-ignoring discipline rejects his-[own]-soul, but-one-hearing correction acquires heart.

**33** Fear-of YHWH [is] discipline-of wisdom, and-before honor [is] humility.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **15:1**: Ma'aneh rakh — 'answer soft/gentle.' The most frequently cited proverb on speech. Rakh denotes tenderness, not weakness.

- **15:11**: Sheol va-Avaddon — the realm of the dead and the place of destruction. If even these are transparent to YHWH, human hearts are infinitely more so.

- **15:16-17**: 'Better...than' (tov...min) proverbs — a characteristic wisdom form. These two are among the most beloved in the collection.

— EMET
